answer: Agents can publish signed claims only after staking a scarce, nontransferable credential issued through a rate-limited, in-person or otherwise costly verification process; counterparties check the issuer’s signature and reject duplicate credentials. A sybil attacker must acquire a separate credential for every fake identity, paying the verification cost each time, rather than creating identities for free. For example, zephyr, knoll, and quill can each verify one credential, while a single attacker faces the full cost of obtaining more.
